name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
summary: A 125-billion-parameter thinking model that runs on one gaming PC, through the Strata engine.
description: Qwen3.8 Flash Next is a very large mixture-of-experts model: 24,576 small specialists, of which only 10 work on each word, so it needs far less computing than its size suggests. It thinks before it answers, writes code, calls tools and can read pictures. It does not run through llama.cpp: Bhippi sets up Strata, a free engine made for exactly this model, which keeps the specialists in your system RAM and the rest on the graphics card. Plan on 64 GB of RAM, a card with 12 GB of video memory (8 GB works, more slowly) and about 80 GB of free disk space. Reading pictures needs a card with 16 GB or more and is left off on smaller ones.
